title: TypeScript
description: Type-checking and input-boundary conventions for TypeScript projects.

rules.instruction: Keep the repository's compiler checks enabled. Prefer strict mode when setting up a new TypeScript project.
rules.verification: Run the project's type-check command with its committed TypeScript configuration.

rules.instruction: Receive external payloads as unknown and validate them before using them as domain types.
rules.verification: Exercise valid, missing and malformed values in boundary tests.

rules.instruction: Update shared types and consumers together when changing public interfaces.
rules.verification: Compile affected packages and verify compatibility with supported consumers.
